messages:
Maria (partnerships): FYI — Atlas Systems signed an SI MOU with us and CloudVendor. We need a short lead-routing play for co-sell + marketplace deals. Who owns initial inbound leads? 
Jamal (sales): Congrats. Do we have account overlap? If Atlas covers EMEA field, how do we map EU accounts vs our AEs? 
Alex (AE): For existing customers, AEs should remain primary. New logos introduced by Atlas -> assign to SI-queue for joint outreach. 
Simon (si-liaison): We want a 3-way handoff: Atlas → SI-queue → AE@region for qualification. Atlas will submit leads via the CloudVendor marketplace form. 
Kara (revops): OK, we need SFDC flags. Proposed fields: lead.Source = "Atlas_SI", lead.Partner_Owner = "Atlas", lead.Assigned_Queue = "SI-Atlas-Queue". Can someone confirm? 
Olivia (partnerships PM): I can draft the playbook doc with flow diagram and SLA (48h ack, 5bd qualification). Link I'll use: https://confluence.redwood.com/partners/atlas-si-playbook (placeholder) 
Maria (partnerships): Include rules of engagement: no cold-reassignment for 7 days, SI gets first-touch credit if introduced, AE can request co-sell within 3bd. 
Jamal (sales): Need clarity on pipeline credit and commission splits. Carlos on finance should review but we need interim rule. 
Kara (revops): Interim: create a 'SI Introduced' campaign and tag opportunities. Revops will run a weekly sync to reassign after 7 days with approvals. 
Simon (si-liaison): Atlas requests joint announcement when a deal > $200k in ACV closes. Need legal sign-off on joint logo use. 
Leo (legal): I'll draft a simple LOA template for joint announcements and a logo usage checklist. Expect a draft by EOD Tue. 
Olivia (partnerships PM): Action items: 1) Kara — add SFDC fields + assignment rule 2) Olivia — publish playbook draft 3) Leo — LOA draft 4) Jamal/Alex — confirm commission interim. 
Kara (revops): Noted. Quick SFDC rule snippet for review:
```
IF Lead.Source = 'Atlas_SI' THEN Owner = 'Queue: SI-Atlas-Queue' AND Tag = 'si_introduced'
```
Maria (partnerships): Great — please ping this thread when SFDC rule is live. :thumbsup: 
Simon (si-liaison): We'll brief Atlas next Wed in partner ops call. 
Alex (AE): I'll block time to review playbook. 
Jamal (sales): +1. Thanks all.
